title: Cherrypicking from CSV using Opentrons
author: Opentrons
materials: Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Upload CSV and set mounts
steps.instruction: In the Opentrons protocol builder, upload the prepared .csv file and specify the mount side (left or right) for the P20 GEN2 and P300 GEN2 single‑channel electronic pipettes.

steps.title: Download generated protocol
steps.instruction: Download the Python protocol file that the builder creates to your local computer.

steps.title: Upload protocol to OT App
steps.instruction: Open the Opentrons App (OT App) and upload the downloaded protocol file.

steps.title: Set up deck
steps.instruction:
Arrange the deck according to the deck map:
- Slot 4: Opentrons 4‑in‑1 tuberack set with a 4 × 6 insert holding 2 ml Eppendorf snap‑cap tubes.
- One position for an IDT 96‑deepwell plate.
- 20 µl tiprack(s) for the P20 pipette.
- 300 µl tiprack(s) for the P300 pipette.
Include the Opentrons P20‑ and P300‑single‑channel electronic pipettes (GEN2) and the corresponding tipracks.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipettes
steps.instruction: Using the OT App, run the calibration routine to calibrate the deck positions, tipracks, and both the P20 and P300 pipettes. Follow the app’s on‑screen instructions for tip‑calibration and labware‑calibration.

steps.title: Run protocol
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT App. The robot will perform the custom cherry‑picking from the 4 × 6 tuberack (2 ml Eppendorf tubes) to the IDT 96‑deepwell plate and then transfer the contents back to new tubes on the tuberack as defined in the CSV.
